commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question "Use Sentry or self-hosted GlitchTip for web app error tracking?" \
  --context "Sentry: free to 5k errors/month, then \$26/month; session replay included; hosted, no upkeep.
GlitchTip: free, runs on our VPS, but we patch and back it up ourselves (about 1 hour/month).
Nothing is wired in yet; I'll integrate whichever you pick." \
  --option "Sentry" --option "GlitchTip (self-hosted)" --recommended "Sentry"
